description: What lampstand rooms enable seeds into a house's rooms/ folder, and what lampstand init and upgrade plant there once [modules] rooms is true. Each entry copies template to destination only when the destination is missing. An entry carrying room is an example room row: the alias it is shown under, never written into agora's config by lampstand. The rooms provision is not planted here: enable files it as a proposal from provision/room-messages.md, for the operator to adopt.
